content: Əgwa Mǝɗǝfau Nyinyau Ənga Huɗǝ Ndzǝndzǝ Nǝ Hyal
Tǝma, kǝ yi nggari vanyi ɗahǝ dzǝdzǝgamǝ sara wu ki Hyal kǝra a vǝr na anǝ waladi mǝɗǝfǝ ˈyar kau, “Maˈya mau, hya biya pǝna ǝgwa huɗǝ ndzǝndzǝ Hyal mǝɗǝfǝ kau, a gyu duniya.”
Kǝ waladi nǝ tanggǝrma kǝ biya, kǝ ji biya pǝna nǝ nya ǝgwa a gyu duniya. Kǝ mbǝlgǝ pǝziya dzǝ ar dza njira ǝnga mǝtsamǝ nǝ sǝr tagǝ kau, ǝnga nda vǝr dlǝvǝ sǝra a papa nyi.
Minu nyi, tǝma waladi nǝ mǝthlǝkura nyi shabiya ǝgwa nyi a gwar tsadau, tǝma ˈyimi kǝra a gwa sha aga mashi ndǝ tǝtau, ba sǝra a gwagwa kuɗǝ patǝu.
Kǝ nǝ makǝrkura nyi tsu biya, kǝ ji biya shabiya nǝ nya ǝgwa a gu dǝlˈyar ǝnga mandǝliˈyar, kǝ ˈyimi kǝra a gwa sha aga mashi.
Kǝ yi nggari waladi kǝra ǝnga dǝnama ar kǝra ˈyimi a vǝr na,

content.text: ndǝra saya ɗa, naja ngǝ ǝshina,
Arya nja nyi a pǝnar nda mashi,
mashi nji cici gǝ Hyal ǝnga mashi nabiˈyar.
Kǝja ga nǝ ndari mashi aga nda sa,

content: Kǝ yi nggari ɗahǝu sara dar bagadiya nyi, a vǝr na,

content.text: Numa ngau, jijiri ǝnga tsatsaˈa nga nyi.”

content: Kǝ waladi nǝ foɗǝkura nyi pǝna ǝgwa nyi a dar pǝci, kǝ ji cakǝr nyi dǝnama nǝ titiˈwa nji ǝnga uˈur pǝci.
Ndǝ titiˈwanakǝr arya kwakwaɗǝkura pǝca nyi, ba ndǝ gu diɗa thlǝmǝr Hyal, ndǝra ǝnga dǝnama ar kǝra ɓwaɓwatǝˈyar kǝ patǝu, ama kǝ ndǝ nggǝl ara tubi ǝnga fal Hyal.
Waladi nǝ tǝfukura nyi pǝna nǝ nya ǝgwa a dar tsǝkafǝ nǝ sǝr tagǝ kau, tǝma, kǝ tǝlkur nyi haɗiya dzǝ ǝnga kuthlǝu. Nji tsu nda vǝr ɗǝ hira nda ara ɓwaɓwatǝu.
Ndǝ dumwa ǝnga diɗa Hyal arya ɓwaɓwatǝ kǝra nda a gwa ǝnga shilǝgǝ kǝra ar dza nda, ama kǝ ndǝ nggǝl ara tubi.
Waladi nǝ kwakura nyi shabiya sǝra a gu ǝgwa nyi a gwu dǝl dǝgal Yifǝratǝsu, tǝma, kǝ ˈyimi kǝra a gwa shiˈwau, aga tǝlˈya
r sara dǝ wu sǝbiyar pǝci uya lagur shida.
Kǝ yi lari mambǝl ɗǝmwaˈyiˈyar makǝr kǝra a papa bwanja, biya sara wu miya pabǝr vuwa kau, ǝnga sara wu miya sǝr tagǝ kau, ba ǝnga sara wu miya nabi fati.
Nanda mambǝl ɗǝmwaˈyiˈyar ngau, kǝra a vǝr mǝl sǝ dǝdǝgur. Nda vǝr biya aga nda maˈyi a ndǝra tǝltǝlˈyar nǝ patǝr duniya, aga nda tsǝmiya dzǝ aga sa pa ar pǝci dǝgal nǝ Hyal Dǝgal Dǝnama.

Hya ɗǝngari sǝra Yesu nana, abǝr, “Kǝja ya vǝr shili ǝnggǝr ndǝr hǝl! Ndǝr barka ngǝ ndǝra pabǝr kǝrnyi ju vǝr sǝkǝ shili ɗa ǝnga ji hari kari nyi camǝu, ara ja sara nggya turusu, nja lari tursukura ja.”
Tǝma, kǝ ndǝ tsǝmiya tǝl tǝlˈyar kǝ patǝ a shili ar vi zǝmǝu, vira nju ngga ǝnga miya njir Yahudiya Amagidanu.
Waladi nǝ mǝɗǝfǝkura nyi shabiya sǝra gu ǝgwa nyi a dǝmǝlmau. Kǝ ɗahǝ dzǝdzǝgamǝu, hyaˈari sara ndar tsǝkafǝ wu ki Hyal ju na, “A ɗari!”
Kǝ sǝm par ǝnga dǝraghi par ǝnga dlǝɗǝ par ǝnga madiya kǝnggǝɗǝr ˈyiˈyi kǝra gǝra saya ɗa ǝnggǝra ndǝ shili wu duniya. Kǝnggǝɗǝ kau, madiya madiya kǝnggǝɗǝr ˈyiˈyi ngau.

Najaka madiya mǝlmau, ba ji tǝkǝbiya dzǝ bwata makǝru, kǝ madiya mǝlmǝ nǝ ˈyiˈyi pamǝpamǝ dlanakǝr. Kǝ Hyal ɗǝngari ǝnga Babilanu madiya mǝlmau, ba Hyal nǝ nyi kyakiwa nyinyau ǝnga huɗǝ ndzǝndzǝ nǝ Hyal aga ja sa.
Kalar dzǝgu dǝl sanakǝr ǝnga kalar mǝˈyar sanakǝr, nji aˈyi ɓǝra lar nda mai.
Sara dǝmǝlmau, kǝ madiya mǝtǝndili tǝtǝɗau a shidar kǝra nji. Kǝ ndǝ dzǝgwa diɗa Hyal arya ɓwaɓwatǝ nǝ mǝtǝndili kau. Ɓwabwata nyi dzadzau gagaɗau.
